title: Anna at the Supermarket
text:
Anna goes to the supermarket on Saturday. She has a shopping list in her hand. The list has bread, milk, eggs and apples. She buys everything in one hour.

After the shop, Anna goes home with two big bags. She puts the milk in the fridge. Her brother helps her with the apples. They have a nice lunch together.

questions.text: What is on Anna's shopping list?
Where does Anna put the milk?
Why is a shopping list useful for Anna?
options: She does not forget any food
She wants to go to the park

questions.text: What can we guess about Anna's brother?
options: He is kind and likes to help

paragraph_translations: Anna idzie do supermarketu w sobotę. Ma w ręce listę zakupów. Na liście są chleb, mleko, jajka i jabłka. Wszystko kupuje w ciągu godziny.
Po zakupach Anna wraca do domu z dwiema dużymi torbami. Wkłada mleko do lodówki. Jej brat pomaga jej z jabłkami. Razem jedzą miły obiad.
